# Genie Media & Studio

> Digital marketing agency and creative production studio based in
> Visakhapatnam (Vizag), India. We provide SEO, Google and Facebook Ads, social
> media marketing, website and e-commerce development, video production, and
> podcast studio rentals.

Genie Media & Studio combines strategy, design, content and technology. The
team works with startups and established businesses across India, Australia and
the United States.

- Location: 5A2, 4th Floor, KP Icon, KP Infra, Yendada, Visakhapatnam - 530045
- Phone: +91 9032845433
- Email: admin@geniemedia.in
- Hours: Monday-Friday 10:00-19:00 IST, Saturday 10:00-16:00 IST

## Pages

- [Home](https://geniemedia.in/): Overview of services, portfolio and client testimonials.
- [About](https://geniemedia.in/about): Who we are, our mission and vision.
- [Services](https://geniemedia.in/services): All four service lines side by side.
- [Digital Marketing](https://geniemedia.in/digital_marketing): SEO, paid ads, social media, content strategy and personal branding.
- [Web Development](https://geniemedia.in/web_development): Custom websites, e-commerce, web applications and ongoing maintenance.
- [Production House](https://geniemedia.in/production_house): Video production, event and wedding coverage, photography, post-production and live streaming.
- [Podcast Studio](https://geniemedia.in/podcast_studio): Fully equipped podcast studio rental in Visakhapatnam.
- [Projects](https://geniemedia.in/projects): Portfolio of delivered client websites.
- [Reviews](https://geniemedia.in/reviews): Video testimonials from clients.
- [Blog](https://geniemedia.in/blogs): Articles on digital marketing and web development.
- [Contact](https://geniemedia.in/contact): Enquiry form, office address and map.
